title: 3 PMA cadets finish Korean language course with honors

blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Three Philippine Military Academy Class of 2029 cadets completed their Korean language course with distinction before attending military academies in South Korea as part of a foreign exchange program. Army Cadet Charlie Mark Bumanglag, a 20-year-old resident of Baguio City, topped the course attended by 69 cadets and officers from 25 countries
